trap-thesis-restatement.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) MATH findings. (1) STRAND/CELL TYPE ERROR in the (n,K) = (2, 4_1) prediction: it assigns the figure-eight the cell lambda_K = (2,2), a partition of 4, while stating in the same bullet that 'figure-8 is a 3-strand braid'. The Wedderburn cells of H_3 are [3], [2,1], [1^3]; none is (2,2), and the self-conjugate one is [2,1]. The parenthetical 'the unique self-conjugate cell of H_3 subset H_4 structure' is correct only about H_4 - [2,2] is indeed the unique self-conjugate partition of 4 (conjugation pairs [4]<->[1^4], [3,1]<->[2,1,1]) - so the block is mixing H_3 and H_4 cells. (2) REPRESENTATION-THEORY ERROR: 'B_n-action (here B_5 via S_5 symmetry of Bring): permutes the same 4 values via the regular representation of S_5 on Q(zeta_5)'. Q(zeta_5) is 4-dimensional over Q and carries Gal(Q(zeta_5)/Q) = Z/4; the regular representation of S_5 is 120-dimensional and S_5 does not act on Q(zeta_5) that way. (3) The .ts authorNotes call 5_2 a '4-strand braid'; 5_2 has braid index 3.
